verdict.rationale: Jan is local-first: its docs say it runs entirely on your hardware, collects zero data until you opt in, and runs everything locally when you want. In practice, data residency is wherever your own machine is. There is no evidence of explicit storage-location or region controls, and when cloud models are used, data residency depends on third-party providers. Missing for 10: documented user-selectable data storage location, region/residency controls for cloud-connected usage, independent corroboration.
